summary: Observability readiness controls were added for Sentry configuration, redacted structured logging, protected readiness, alerting, incident response, rollback and customer communication runbooks.
redactionConfirmation: All secrets, tokens, credentials, connection strings, and access-granting values are redacted.
controlsVerified: Sentry client config disables default PII and strips request/user fields before send.
Sentry server config disables default PII and strips request/user fields before send.
Sentry edge config disables default PII and strips request/user fields before send.
Source-map upload is gated on SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN, SENTRY_ORG and SENTRY_PROJECT.
Central logger redacts secrets, tokens, cookies, sessions and avoidable PII.
Central logger includes requestId and only includes safe organizationId values.
Standardized security events are exported and test-covered.
/api/ready checks Supabase connectivity and grouped Stripe, Redis and Sentry config without exposing values.
Sensitive error reporting returns sanitized error metadata and captures Sentry exceptions with sanitized extra context.
Alerting, incident response, rollback and customer communication runbooks exist for SEV-1 and SEV-2 operations.
Release readiness gates require incident and rollback owners before release sign-off.

sourceMaps.accidentalUploadGuard: Next config is not wrapped with withSentryConfig unless all release-upload credentials are present.

checks: Sentry source-map upload credentials present when release uploads are expected

notes: This evidence file intentionally contains no secrets, tokens, customer PII, cookie values or stack traces.
CI command output must be attached before production release sign-off.
